text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa didn't show up for
training, so I
decide to go looking for
her.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Damn, we lost again! It's no fair to
recruit El for
help!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Aerial attacks are a condor's
specialty!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Just keep giving me the ball and I'll
keep droppin'
'em in!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Uh, El... I think your trainer is here...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Qué? What's up, Trainer? You need help
with
somethin'?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's right! I totally spaced!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I was only gonna play for a little bit,
but
my
competitive spirit got the best of
me...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'll be careful next time.
I'm really sorry...
